title: Common Modules — the generative core
thesis: These are the load-bearing common modules of the VP framework. They are the primary attack surface (the claims a critic must break) AND the generators: with the Concept Dictionary plus these modules, roughly 80% of the framework is forced — a reader could reconstruct most of it. Two are named by the author as the irreducible core: Quantum light emergence and DNA interpretation. Each module is a bundle of dictionary terms whose canonical derivation lives in one place; downstream volumes inherit it and re-derive nothing.

modules.name: The R19 switch on a jammed substrate
modules.forces: Every volume is this ONE cubic, specialized. A bistable double-well ṡ = g·s − s³ + h (R19) sitting on a jammed elastic solid where c² = B/ρ. The double-well arises from the stiffness shell (a frequency-selective rigid shell), not mere hardness — which is why it is a switch.
modules.reach: All 30 volumes inherit this object: 23/30 carry R19 explicitly, 27/30 emerge from it. It is the shared bedrock the other three modules specialize.
modules.attack_surface: Is reality really one cubic on a jammed solid? Break the substrate (c² = B/ρ) or the bistable normal form and the entire program falls at once.

modules.name: Quantum light emergence
modules.forces: Light is the lattice's single surviving longitudinal elastic wave (c² = B/ρ, shear modulus → 0); a single photon is one R19 flip; the event quantum fixes the unit of time; and the quantum size D = 2λ_C,e ≈ 4.852620 pm is the one internal length, fixed by the electron mass. Colour is then the propagation angle χ(λ) of that wave — light rides an integer dent chain, sinχ = λ/(mD), m = ⌈λ/D⌉.
modules.reach: Forces the physics constants with NO fit: mₚ/mₑ = 6π⁵ (−19 ppm), the per-nucleon rate ν_p = 3π⁴ (with the electron rate νₑ = 1), the EM angle law sinχ = λ/(mD) unifying near- and far-field, and electromagnetism on the same substrate. (α_em is the one measured, open input.)
modules.self_completeness: Closed and non-circular. D is fixed INTERNALLY by the electron mass — it never reads a wavelength. The justification is the 633/532 closure: TWO independent measured laser lines, HeNe red 632.99 nm (m = 130443) and green 532 nm (m = 109632), both map to integer dents against that SAME D, and their ratio closes ((λ/D)₆₃₃/(λ/D)₅₃₂ = 632.99/532). The single anchor (633) alone could be dismissed as a fit; the second line (532) closing against the same invariant is what proves D was not tuned. The committed angles χ(633)/χ(532) are an armed falsifier — a wrong D breaks the closure.
modules.attack_surface: The most exposed quantitative claim — and the most checkable. If c² = B/ρ and the n-fold rate law ν_n = nπ^(2(n−1)) are wrong, the constants do not follow. mₚ/mₑ = 6π⁵ to 19 ppm is the headline target a critic will test first.

modules.name: DNA interpretation (γ LEVEL + A4 SHAPE)
modules.forces: A locus is read in one deterministic pass. Measured γ = −mean NN stacking ΔG (SantaLucia, corr(γ,GC)=0.998) sets the R19 threshold: spinodal 2(γ/3)^1.5, barrier γ²/4, dwell γ^1.5. A4 places the SHAPE (shell, anchor, loops, helical phase). The emergence engine then forces identity, developmental order (argsort γ) and relative size — from measurement, never a fit.
modules.reach: Forces all of biology. Every neuron, sense, organ, clock and disease inherits node identity and order from this single reading; the DNA atlas is the single source of truth and downstream volumes re-emerge nothing.
modules.inherited_by: 24/31 carry γ; nearly all biology inherits the atlas
modules.attack_surface: The no-tuning claim lives or dies here. If measured γ does NOT force the switch threshold — if a fit is hiding anywhere — biology collapses to curve-fitting. Every γ is re-derived byte-identically from NCBI GRCh38, so the input is auditable.

modules.name: Rotor inflow & emission (three rotations)
modules.forces: A co-rotating PAIR cannot self-propel (a No-Go theorem), so the irreducible interaction of a rotating arrangement is the three-body triangle; co-rotation then builds large-scale rotation with inflow (suction) and emission. The vacuum medium flows into matter at rate Q ∝ mass.
modules.reach: Forces continuum flow on the jammed medium, plate break-up (geodynamics), gravity as inflow, and the galactic acceleration scale a₀ = cH₀/2π — the framework's one unique cosmological prediction.
modules.attack_surface: If three rotations do NOT necessarily produce inflow and emission — if the No-Go on a co-rotating pair fails — then gravity-as-inflow and the a₀ prediction do not follow.
